svg.title: Enterprise LLM Gateway — high-level deployment topology
svg.desc: Side-by-side deployment models: Google Cloud Phase 1 (implemented) and Private Data Center (documented future). Same Gateway binary and configuration model. Single-region HA in v1. Controlled egress.
